thread:
mara: Hey folks — updated a quick mock for the Playground structured-output panel + function-def flow. Main asks: 1) keyboard-first flow (Tab order, shortcuts) 2) copy tweaks for "Add function" / "Use schema" 3) run-history quick actions (re-run, open inputs, export schema). Link to fig: https://figma.mock/redwood/playground/so-v3 :eyes:

jas: Nice! overall 👍. Biggest friction I saw is the secondary dropdown for schema versions — two clicks to copy JSON. can we add a one-click copy icon?

lin: Agree on copy. Also keyboard: will Tab go into the code editor or jump to the next control? we should ensure `Ctrl+Enter` triggers a re-run, not the editor's default.

ollie: Mock note: the function list feels heavy. Suggest collapsed view with name + signature, expand for details. saves vertical space for long run-history.

mara: Good calls. What about an inline quick-actions bar on each run-history row: [re-run] [open inputs] [copy schema] [export]. keyboard shortcuts: r = re-run, o = open, c = copy when row selected. Thoughts?

ben_pm: r/o/c shortcuts sound fine. Need to surface that mapping somewhere — maybe a tiny ? tooltip on the run-history header. Also for exports, default to JSON but include CSV for flat outputs.

jas: Accessibility nits: ensure the copy icon has aria-label and keyboard focus style. Also color contrast on the selected-run highlight is a bit low for some themes.

a11y-bot: Automated check: focusable elements >= 44px? some run-history buttons are 32px. Flagged. Color contrast for selected row text: 3.6:1 (fails). Recommend >4.5:1 for normal text.

lin: For function definitions: add an inline validator as you type (required/optional params). Show a red badge on the function card if schema invalid, with `View error` quicklink. keeps evals from failing silently.

ollie: UX copy: change "Add function" to "Register function"? or "Add tool"? "Register" suggests persistence which is accurate (it lives on the project).

mara: I like "Register tool" personally. But engineering prefers shorter labels. maybe "Add tool (r)" where (r) is the shortcut hint?

ben_pm: Also think about the default behavior of re-run: if the tool set changed between runs, prompt: "Toolset changed since this run — re-run with original snapshot or current toolset?" small modal with "Original" / "Current" buttons.

jas: Good call. For the schema editor component: can we show a compact diff view if the schema differs from the saved version? small colored bar left of the editor.

mara: Implementation question — does runtime snapshotting already store the function schemas per run? @runbot any info?

runbot: runtime: snapshotting for tools is stored per-run since 2024-11-02. Field name: `tool_snapshot_v2`. Retrieval endpoint: `GET /runs/:id/tool_snapshot` (internal).

lin: Nice. So showing a diff is feasible. UX: default to show original inputs collapsed, with a "show changes" link. prevents noise.

a11y-bot: Keyboard nav proposal: allow arrow-up/down to move between run rows. Enter expands details. Provide skip link to jump directly to active run.

mara: Design iteration: I'll update mock to: - one-click copy icon with accessible label - compact function cards w/ expand - run-history inline quick-actions + keyboard mappings shown in header - diff indicator in editor - color + size fixes per a11y-bot

ollie: For the copy interaction, show a small toast: "Schema copied — press paste to use" with an undo? Not necessary for copy but maybe ephemeral toast with check icon.

jas: Minor copy tweak: instead of "Export" use "Download" for clarity.

ben_pm: Also add telemetry names for the quick-actions (run_history.re_run, run_history.copy_schema, run_history.open_inputs). helps product map usage.

mara: Perfect. I'll produce an updated screen + include a keyboard flow diagram. anyone want to own accessibility validation when I hand off?

lin: I can run the a11y checklist and test with VoiceOver.

ollie: I'll do a quick prototype of the compact function card animation (expand/collapse).

jas: I'll check copy and microcopy edge cases (i18n).

mara: Awesome. Thanks all — will post updated fig and a short gif of the keyboard flow later today. :rocket:

runbot: deploy note: playground staging build deployed at 2024-12-11T09:12Z — use `staging/playground` to test the new panel.
